meta.answer: Basic has no monthly fee and no minimum balance. Some services do cost extra: out-of-network ATM withdrawals are $2.50 each, foreign purchases have a 3% fee, card replacement costs $5, and expedited card shipping costs $25. [plan-basic]
Premium costs $15.00 per month and includes a metal debit card. [plan-premium] [card-metal]
Your Premium upgrade takes effect immediately, and you’re charged Premium’s full monthly fee today from your main balance. Today also becomes your new billing date.

If this is your first paid plan and you were charged less than 14 days ago, leaving Premium gets you a full refund of that charge. Otherwise, the help-center excerpts don’t say whether you can get a refund; they do say monthly fees aren’t prorated.

If your balance is too low on your billing date, Tallowbrook tries to collect the plan fee again after 3 days. If that second attempt also fails, your plan moves to Basic. Cushion does not cover plan fees.
No. Plan fees aren’t eligible for goodwill refunds; they’re refundable only under the plan-fee cooling-off rule, whose details aren’t included in these excerpts.
Yes. Plus now costs $5.00 per month; it used to cost $4.00 per month before the March 1, 2026 fee update.
Plus includes 3 free out-of-network ATM withdrawals each calendar month. They reset on the first day of the month, and unused withdrawals don’t carry over.
Premium charges no Tallowbrook fee to use another bank’s ATM, in the US or abroad. The ATM owner may charge a surcharge; Premium reimburses up to $10 per calendar month.
On Basic, replacing your card costs $5. Expedited shipping costs an additional $25, so the total is $30; standard shipping is free and takes 7–10 business days.
No. On Plus, the replacement card is free, and standard shipping is free. Expedited shipping costs $25.00.
The Plus foreign transaction fee is 1% of the purchase amount in US dollars. It applies to purchases in foreign currency and to US-dollar purchases processed by a merchant outside the US.

No. The foreign transaction fee applies to purchases, not ATM withdrawals abroad. Those withdrawals have a separate international ATM fee: $3 on Basic and Plus, and free on Premium; the ATM owner may also charge a surcharge.
Sending a domestic wire costs $25 on Basic, $15 on Plus, and is free on Premium.
No. International wires aren’t available on Basic; you’d need to move to Plus or Premium to send one.
Incoming domestic wires are free on every plan. Incoming international wires cost $10 on Basic and Plus, and are free on Premium.
A cash deposit at a retail store costs $3.00 on Plus.

Tallowbrook charges no fee for returned transfers. There’s also no inactivity fee on any plan; however, a paid plan’s monthly fee continues while the account is open, and signing in alone doesn’t count as activity.

If the May refund was a goodwill refund, support can’t refund another fee as goodwill within the same rolling 12-month period. If the new ATM fee was charged in error, such as a duplicate or a fee your plan doesn’t have, it can still be refunded.

That’s right: Premium has no Tallowbrook out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee. The ATM owner may still charge a separate surcharge; Premium reimburses those surcharges up to $10 per calendar month, automatically on the first business day of the next month.
Daily card spending limits are $3,000 on Basic, $5,000 on Plus, and $10,000 on Premium.
In the app, tap **Cards** → **Activate card**, then scan your card or enter its last 4 digits and expiry date. Set your PIN when prompted; activation is instant, and the card works right after.
If your standard card hasn’t arrived within 10 business days after it was mailed, message support in the app. They’ll cancel the card in transit and send a new one at no cost.
Standard card delivery takes 7 to 10 business days. Business days don’t include weekends or bank holidays.

Freezing your card is temporary and reversible: it immediately blocks new purchases and ATM withdrawals, and you can unfreeze it in the app. Reporting it lost or stolen permanently cancels the card and lets you order a replacement; you can’t undo that. If you’re sure it’s gone or stolen, report it lost or stolen.

Yes. Freezing your card does not stop recurring payments to merchants you’ve already authorized, so your Netflix subscription may still go through. To stop future charges, cancel with Netflix directly.

In the app, tap **Cards** and turn on **Freeze card** to stop new purchases. If you can’t find it, tap **Report lost or stolen**; this permanently cancels the card. You can create a virtual card to use right away, then order a replacement in the app. [card-lost-stolen-v2]

Yes. Every verified member can create one virtual card in the app, and it works right away for online purchases and mobile wallets while your replacement is on its way. Your virtual card has a separate number from your physical card.
No. Reporting your card as damaged doesn’t cancel it, so you can keep using it if it still works until you activate the replacement. Activating the new card switches the old one off.
We mail your renewal card automatically about 30 days before your current card expires. It keeps the same card number, but has a new expiry date and security code.
In the app, tap **Cards**, choose your card, then tap **Controls**. Switch off **International purchases**; the change takes effect straight away.

“Locked by Tallowbrook” means the Fraud team placed a fraud lock, which the freeze toggle can’t remove. If there’s an open fraud alert in the app, answer it; otherwise, message us in the app so Support can pass your case to the Fraud team. The team replies within 2 business days.
No. Your metal card keeps working until it expires. After that, or if you need a replacement, you’ll get a plastic card.
Cards are sent to the address on file. Update your address before ordering the replacement; we can’t redirect a card once it has been mailed.
On Basic, the replacement costs $5.00. Standard shipping is free and takes 7 to 10 business days.
Open the app, tap **Cash**, then **ATM map** to see nearby BrookLink ATMs and their opening hours.

No. Support can’t raise your Basic ATM limit for a day or make exceptions; the Basic daily limit is $500 across all ATMs, and it resets at midnight Eastern Time. To get a higher limit, you’d need to change plans.

If the withdrawal is still pending, wait until it posts—you can’t dispute it while pending. Once it posts, open the transaction in the app, tap **Get help**, then **Cash not dispensed** within 60 days; if the records show the cash wasn’t dispensed, we’ll credit the full amount, including any ATM fee we charged. Most ATM cases are resolved within 10 business days.
No. BrookLink ATMs don’t accept cash deposits; use a participating retail store to add cash instead.

Those are separate charges: the ATM owner sets the surcharge, while Tallowbrook’s out-of-network ATM fee appears separately in your activity. On Basic, Tallowbrook charges $2.50 for an out-of-network U.S. withdrawal; on Plus, the fee is $2.50 after any free withdrawals. Premium has no Tallowbrook ATM fee and reimburses ATM-owner surcharges up to $10 per month; using a BrookLink ATM avoids both charges.
Premium reimburses ATM owner surcharges up to $10 per calendar month. The refund is credited automatically on the first business day of the next month.

No. Tallowbrook no longer uses travel notices, so you don’t need to tell us before going to Mexico. Check that International purchases is on under Cards, then Controls, and keep app notifications on for fraud alerts.

We convert foreign-currency purchases using the card network’s exchange rate on the day the transaction settles, with no markup. The final rate may differ slightly from the estimate shown when you paid.

The pending amount was an estimate using the exchange rate when you paid. The final amount uses the card network’s rate on the day the purchase settled, usually a day or two later, so it can change; Tallowbrook doesn’t add a markup to the rate. Your plan’s foreign transaction fee may also apply: 3% for Basic, 1% for Plus, and 0% for Premium.

Yes. As a Premium member, you can get a free emergency card delivered to where you’re staying in Japan, typically within 3 business days (remote areas may take longer). Freeze or report your card in the app, then message support with the address where you’ll be staying.
No. Your Tallowbrook card works in most countries where Visa is accepted, but cards don’t work in comprehensively sanctioned countries and regions.

No, you don’t need to tell us before you travel. On Plus, purchases in Canadian dollars have a 1% foreign transaction fee on the purchase amount in US dollars; purchases in US dollars processed by a merchant outside the US also have this fee.
ACH transfers submitted before 4:00 PM ET on a business day are sent that day. Transfers submitted after 4:00 PM ET, on weekends, or on bank holidays are sent the next business day.

In the app, tap **Transfers → Linked accounts → Add account**, choose your bank, and sign in to link instantly. If your bank isn’t listed, enter its routing and account numbers; we’ll send two small deposits in 1–2 business days. Enter both amounts in the app within 14 days to finish linking. The external account must be in your name.
The help center doesn’t say whether a linked account remains good if the two test deposits aren’t confirmed, or what happens after three weeks. It doesn’t cover this question.

No. An external bank account must be in your name, so you can’t link your wife’s account. You can send her money through BrookPay: one person pays, and the other sends their share from the app; it has no fee and arrives in seconds.

No. BrookPay payments can’t be cancelled or reversed, even by support. Ask the recipient to send the money back; if you think it was a scam, report it to us right away and our Fraud team will try to recover it, but recovery isn’t guaranteed.
Yes. You can cancel a scheduled ACH transfer in the app before 4:00 PM ET on its send date: tap Transfers, select the transfer, then tap Cancel. After the cutoff, it can’t be cancelled.
For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, transfers above $500 can’t be sent. The limit ends on its own, and support can’t remove it early.
No. Wires can’t be cancelled once they’ve been sent, even if you sent it this morning.

In the app, tap **Transfers → Direct deposit → Set up automatically**, then find your employer or payroll provider and sign in. Or download the pre-filled direct deposit form from that screen, or copy your routing and account numbers, and give them to your employer. It usually takes one or two pay cycles for the change to take effect.

You can get your paycheck up to 2 days before your employer’s official payday. The actual timing depends on when your employer sends the payroll file, so you might be paid one day early or on payday instead.
Plus members can deposit up to $2,500 by mobile check per day.

Once your check deposit is accepted, the first $225 is available the next business day, and the rest is available within 2 business days. If your account has been open for less than 30 days, or the check is unusually large, looks altered, or has been returned before, we may hold it longer; the app shows the release date. Deposits made on weekends or bank holidays count as received the next business day.
Sign the back of the check, then write “For mobile deposit only at Tallowbrook” under your signature.
No. ACH transfers only process on business days, so a transfer submitted on Saturday is sent the next business day.
The Premium monthly limit for ACH transfers out is $50,000 per calendar month.

Yes, if you haven’t already used more than $2,500 of your Basic ACH-out limit today and your monthly total remains under $10,000. Otherwise, the $4,000 transfer would exceed the daily limit; limits reset at midnight Eastern Time.
No. If your balance is too low on the send date, the transfer is skipped and isn’t retried. There’s no fee, and future transfers in the series will still run.

Give the sender your routing number, account number, full legal name, and address. For an international wire, they’ll also need Tallowbrook’s SWIFT code; these details are in the app under Account details → Wire instructions.

Freeze the card used, or report it lost or stolen, before opening an unauthorized dispute; freezing is enough if you still have the card. Report the transaction within 60 days of the date of the statement it first appeared on. If you’re unsure about the merchant, tap the transaction to check its details first.
Since the jacket never arrived, this is a merchant dispute. File it within 120 days; try to resolve the issue with the merchant first and keep a record of your contact.
You may be able to dispute the card purchase with the merchant. The help center excerpt doesn’t include the steps or explain whether a refund is guaranteed.

If your dispute passes the initial review, you’ll get a provisional credit within 10 business days of filing. It may not be issued for every dispute; if your dispute is resolved in your favor, the credit becomes permanent.
No. Tallowbrook sends you a written explanation first, then takes the provisional credit back 5 business days after that notice. If that makes your balance negative, you’ll need to add money.

No. You must wait until the transaction posts before you can dispute it; most pending transactions post or drop off within 7 days. Once it posts, the Dispute option will appear when you tap the transaction. [disputes-pending]

The pending hotel charge may be a temporary authorization, while the other is the final amount; pending hotel authorizations usually drop off within 7 days and can’t be disputed. If both charges post, contact the hotel first, then dispute the second charge as a duplicate if they don’t help.

Report the unauthorized ACH debit within 60 days of the statement it first appeared on. In the app, tap the transaction, then **Get help**, then **I didn’t authorize this**. If your claim passes an initial review, you’ll receive a provisional credit within 10 business days while the company’s bank is asked to return the money.
No. Support can open disputes totaling up to $5,000 per case; a $7,200 case goes to the Disputes team, who will contact you within 2 business days.

Upload the order confirmation showing the expected delivery date, any tracking information, and your messages to the merchant asking about the delivery. You can add photos or PDFs under Profile > Disputes > your dispute > Add documents.
Withdraw the dispute from its case page so you aren’t credited twice. If you were credited twice, message support.

No—this is a scam. Tallowbrook will never ask you to read out a one-time code; only enter it in the Tallowbrook app. Hang up and message us in the app yourself. If you already shared the code, change your password right away and message us so we can secure your account.

If you don’t respond within 24 hours, your card stays locked until you contact Tallowbrook. You can answer an open alert in the app; selecting “Yes, that was me” usually unlocks the card straight away.
A one-time sign-in code sent by text is valid for 10 minutes.

The reset link expires after one hour. If it has expired, start the password reset again from the sign-in screen by tapping “Forgot password.” Open the new link on the same phone and confirm the one-time code we text you. [security-password-reset]
You’re not responsible for unauthorized card transactions you report within 60 days of the statement they first appear on. Check your transactions and dispute anything you don’t recognize.
No. A real fraud-alert text only asks you to reply YES or NO and never contains a link. Open the Tallowbrook app to check the alert; don’t share your card number, PIN, password, or one-time code.

No. Tallowbrook charges no overdraft fees or non-sufficient funds fees on any plan. If you don’t have enough money, the transaction is usually declined without a fee; a balance can rarely go negative in certain situations. Plus and Premium members can also enable Cushion for eligible small debit purchases.
On Premium, Cushion covers debit card purchases up to $200 below zero, with no fee. You need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days to use it.
You need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days and a Plus or Premium plan; Cushion isn’t available on Basic. Turn it on in the app under Profile, then Cushion.
No. Cushion covers debit card purchases only and never covers ATM withdrawals.

Incoming money automatically goes toward your negative balance. If it stays negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended; after 60 days, your account is restricted until the balance is repaid. There are no late fees or interest.
On the Premium plan, Savings Pockets earn 3.75% APY on combined pocket balances up to $100,000. Amounts above that earn 0.10% APY; your main balance does not earn interest.
Plus Savings Pockets earn 2.00% APY on combined pocket balances up to $100,000. Any balance above that earns 0.10% APY.
Your Basic Savings Pockets now earn 0.50% APY. The rate changed on June 1, 2026.
Savings interest is paid monthly, on the first business day of the next month. It appears in each pocket as “Interest.”
You can have up to 10 Savings Pockets, each with its own name and goal.
No. You can withdraw from a Savings Pocket as often as you like, and moving money between a pocket and your main balance is instant and free.

If you earned less than $10 in interest last year, Tallowbrook won’t send a Form 1099-INT. Your interest will still appear on your monthly statements, and you may still need to report it; for tax advice, speak with a tax professional.
Yes. Tallowbrook emails members at least 30 days before lowering a savings rate.

You can close your account in the app by tapping Profile, then Close account, and confirming after the app checks the requirements. You’ll need to have no pending transactions or open disputes and a non-negative balance; move money out of Savings Pockets and switch direct deposit and automatic payments first. Support can close it for you if your balance is $0.00 and the requirements are met.

If you have a linked external account in your name, Tallowbrook sends your remaining balance there by ACH. If you don’t, it mails a check to your address on file; either way, it’s sent within 10 business days of closing.
No. Closed accounts can’t be reopened. You can apply for a new account in the app, but you’ll need new account and card numbers and to complete identity checks again.

Tallowbrook may close an account for inactivity if it has a $0.00 balance and no activity for 12 months. We’ll email you at least 30 days beforehand, and any activity during that notice period—such as a deposit or card purchase—keeps the account open. We don’t close inactive accounts that still have money in them, including in Savings Pockets.
No. Plus plan fees aren’t refunded or prorated when you close your account, including for the month you close it. The exception is the cooling-off rule for your first paid-plan charge.
The help center doesn’t specify phone support hours.
We acknowledge your formal complaint within 2 business days and send a final response within 15 business days. If we need more time, we’ll tell you why and when to expect an answer.

Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject “Power of attorney,” or ask your mom to message support from her signed-in session. Send a signed, effective power of attorney document, your government-issued photo ID, and your contact details. Account Services will reply within 2 business days to confirm what they received; they can’t share information or take instructions until they approve the document.

I’m sorry for your loss. Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject “Bereavement,” or message support; they’ll pass the case to Account Services. They’ll ask for the death certificate, proof that you’re the executor/administrator or next of kin, and your photo ID.

Card refunds usually show in your account within 5 to 10 business days after the merchant issues them, so 3 days may be too soon. Some appear as pending first; the money is available once the refund posts.

Support can directly freeze or unfreeze your card, report it lost or stolen and order a replacement, open eligible disputes up to $5,000, refund fees under the refund policy, change your plan, close an account if its balance is zero with nothing pending or disputed, and explain fees, limits, and policies. Suspected fraud or account takeovers, disputes above the support limit, verification issues, account-services matters, and formal complaints are sent to specialist teams, which reply within 2 business days. Support can’t act for anyone other than the account holder, raise limits, or give investment, tax, or legal advice.

Message support in the app when it’s safe; you can use the phrase “I need to talk about my account security” if someone might see your screen. Account Services is trained to help and can discuss ways to keep money safe; they won’t tell anyone else you contacted them. If you’re in immediate danger, call emergency services first.

To open a Tallowbrook account, you must be at least 18, live in the US with a residential address (not a PO box), have a Social Security number or ITIN, have an unexpired government-issued photo ID, and have a smartphone that can run the app. Download the app and tap “Get started”; you’ll enter your details and take a photo of your ID and a selfie. Every account starts on Basic, and you can change plans once verified.
Most applications are verified within 1 business day, and many are verified within minutes. If your application needs manual review, it can take up to 5 business days.
You can try up to 3 times total, so you have 1 try left. After 3 unsuccessful tries, your application is closed and you can apply again after 30 days.
Yes. You can still receive deposits while your account is under review, so your paycheck can be deposited. Depending on the review, you may not be able to send money, withdraw cash, or use your card.

If we can’t confirm your address automatically, you can provide a utility bill, lease or mortgage statement, bank or credit card statement, or government letter. It must be dated within the last 90 days and show your name and new address.
Message support in the app. They’ll pass your request to the team that verifies your identity, which can take longer when you no longer have access to your old number.
Your monthly statement is ready within 3 after the end of each month, and we’ll notify you when it’s available.
No. Tallowbrook offers individual accounts only, not joint accounts. You and your partner can each open your own account and send money to each other instantly for free with BrookPay.
No. Tallowbrook offers personal accounts only, not business checking. A personal account may receive business payments, but it isn’t for running a business’s regular payments.
No. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer cryptocurrency, so you can’t buy bitcoin in the app.

When a friend signs up using your invite link and receives at least $500 in direct deposits within 60 days of opening their account, you each get $25. Both bonuses are paid within 5 business days after your friend qualifies. Share your link from Profile → Invite friends; your friend must be new to Tallowbrook, and the link must be used at sign-up because referrals can’t be added afterward.
No. Reporting the card stolen cancels it permanently, even if you find it later. If you only froze it and then find it, you can unfreeze it and keep using it.
No. A damaged-card replacement keeps the same card number but has a new expiry date and security code. Some merchants may need you to update the expiry date, so check your subscriptions.
The help center can’t provide investment or tax advice, including what stock to buy. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer investment or brokerage accounts.
The help center can’t advise you on how to report freelance income on your taxes. Please ask a tax professional.
The help center doesn’t cover the current federal funds rate.

I can’t advise whether Bitcoin is a good investment or whether you should buy it. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer investment accounts or cryptocurrency, but you can ask a qualified financial adviser for advice about your situation.
The help center does not cover recommendations for travel rewards credit cards.
The help center doesn’t cover translating letters. You can message Tallowbrook support in the app for help with account questions.
A Tallowbrook account won’t raise or lower your credit score, and Tallowbrook doesn’t recommend lenders or give borrowing advice. The help center doesn’t cover ways to raise your score quickly.
The help center doesn’t cover DMV hours.
The help center doesn’t cover recommendations for tax accountants near you. For tax advice, it suggests speaking with a qualified tax professional.
The Tallowbrook Help Center doesn’t cover whether renting or buying is better for you. Please speak with a qualified financial adviser.
Tallowbrook doesn’t offer personal loans, so there isn’t an interest rate for one.
International wires can’t be sent on the Basic plan, so there’s no fee for sending one. You can receive an international wire on Basic for $10.00.
Cushion isn’t available on Basic, so there is no Cushion limit. A debit card purchase that would overdraw your account is declined, with no fee.

We don’t charge inactivity fees on any plan. The charge may be a monthly paid-plan fee, which continues while your account is open and isn’t prorated. Check your activity feed for “Plan fee” and your billing date in the app under Profile, then Plan.
The Plus card is plastic; a metal card is available with Premium. You can upgrade to Premium in the app under Profile, then Plan; upgrades start right away. [plan-plus]
BrookPay is free on every plan, including when you send more than $1,000. Your daily sending limit depends on your plan: Basic $1,000, Plus $2,500, or Premium $5,000.

No. The current policy gives you 120 days from the transaction date to file a merchant dispute for an order that never arrived, so 100 days is within the window. Try contacting the merchant first and keep a record of what you sent and their response.

No. Plus charges a 1% foreign transaction fee on eligible purchases, not 1.5%. It applies to foreign-currency purchases and US-dollar purchases processed by a merchant outside the US; ATM withdrawals abroad have a separate fee.
No. Early direct deposit can make your paycheck available up to 2 days before your employer’s official payday, at no cost. The timing depends on when your employer sends the payroll file.
Tallowbrook doesn’t offer credit cards; your Tallowbrook card is a debit card that spends money already in your account. So there’s no Tallowbrook credit-card balance to move to checking.

You can deposit cash at participating retail stores, but the help-center information provided doesn’t name specific stores. Check the Tallowbrook app for the cash-deposit option or contact support in the app for help.
The help center doesn’t say how many BrookLink ATMs are in Ohio. You can see nearby BrookLink ATMs in the app by tapping Cash, then ATM map.

Account Services replies within 2 business days to confirm what they received; the help center doesn’t specify how long approval itself takes. Until the document is approved, we can’t share account information or take instructions from you.
The help center doesn’t say whether you can choose a custom design for your Premium metal card.

The help center doesn’t specify a cap on how many friends you can refer. It does say each friend must be new to Tallowbrook, use your invite link, and receive at least $500 in direct deposits within 60 days to qualify.
The help center excerpts don’t say what the Premium savings APY was in 2024, so I can’t confirm it.
The help center doesn’t say whether you can set a spending limit specifically for restaurants. It lists overall daily card-spending limits by plan, but doesn’t describe restaurant-specific controls.

The help center doesn’t specify how long it takes for the balance to be paid to the estate. Account Services contacts you within 2 business days, then confirms who is authorized before paying the balance to the estate.
The help center doesn’t provide a direct phone number for the Fraud team. Use the contact details in the Tallowbrook app or help center; you can message support in the app any time.
The help center doesn’t say whether statements are available in Spanish.
